title: 2017 Bowman Draft Chrome Refractor #BDC-9 Alex Scherff
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2017 Bowman Draft Chrome Refractor #BDC-9 trading card features Alex Scherff, a Boston Red Sox player. It is a sports trading card with a Chrome Refractor finish, manufactured by Bowman Draft. The card is part of the 2017 Bowman Draft set and has a card number of BDC-9. 

The card is perfect for collectors and fans of baseball and the Boston Red Sox. It is not autographed and is not a vintage card. The card is in great shape and is a great addition to any collection. Get this card now to add to your collection!
